title: Sinkhole Throat
description: An FM sine bass that swallows itself: each hit fires a steep downward pitch envelope so the tone drops like a collapsing floor, while the FM index, harmonicity and a noise-fed ladder filter morph on mutually-prime LFOs across a 32-cycle arc. The pitch drop accelerates and deepens over the loop, growing from a gritty growl into a broken, choking bass-drop sweep.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [c1 eb1] g0>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(23).range(3, 13)).fmh("<0.5 1 1.5 0.75>/4")
    .penv(saw.slow(32).range(-12, -34)).pattack(0.001).pdecay(sine.slow(19).range(0.18, 0.05)).pcurve(1)
    .accelerate(saw.slow(32).range(-0.3, -1.4))
    .noise(sine.slow(11).range(0.02, 0.18))
    .lpf(sine.slow(17).range(180, 2200)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(8, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(29).range(2, 5)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.14)
    .crush("<16 10 7 6>/8").shape(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.55)).distort("<0 0 0.3 0.6>/16")
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.22).sustain(0.4).release(0.07)
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).crush(5).pan(0.75))
    .room(0.22).delay("0.3:0.5:0.55")
    .gain(0.9)
)
